description: A utility class for managing HTTP session attributes within a web application, providing methods to get, set, and remove session attributes.

classes.name: SessionUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to interact with HTTP session attributes.

methods.name: getSessionAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves a session attribute by key, with generic return type.

methods.name: removeSessionAttribute
methods.description: Removes a session attribute by key.

methods.name: setSessionAttribute
methods.description: Sets a session attribute with a specified key and value.
